answer: In an economy of AI agents, a Sybil-resistant mechanism can be achieved through a reputation system tied to a unique, costly-to-create identity. Each agent is assigned a digital onyx token, which serves as a unique identifier. When an agent misbehaves, its token is temporarily downgraded, akin to a comet's tail marking its path. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to acquire and manage numerous tokens, which becomes prohibitively expensive as the number of tokens approaches the nadir of usability, thereby deterring large-scale Sybil attacks.
